newsitem.title: UKRAINE: AGROKHLEB-Ukraine sets higher grain/sunseed prices.
newsitem.headline: AGROKHLEB-Ukraine sets higher grain/sunseed prices.

text.p: The following is a direct contribution from SovEcon Ltd, an independent research organisation specialising in agricultural production and trade in the former Soviet Union, in association with Ukragroconsult, a private Ukrainian agricultural consultancy based in Kiev.
UKRAINE ANNOUNCES GRAIN AND SUNSEED PROCUREMENT PRICES
KIEV, July 10 - The Ukrainian government has set commodities procurement prices which are above domestic market prices in hope of getting farmers to sell to the state.
Sunflowerseed was set at $200 per tonne, about 10 percent above the domestic market level.
State procurement prices for grain are estimated to be 10-20 percent above those the free market is able to offer (Table 1).
As a result, grain prices may increase over July-September, when procurements are usually carried out.
There are questions over whether the state will actually be able to pay in cash.
Due to continued financial constraints, barter deals may become the most important marketing channel.
